capabilities: hide information inside a spoiler block
hide the text again by double-clicking
extras: README states this version includes only basic functionality and invites contributions, such as rendering Markdown inside spoilers or a command to reveal all spoilers on a page.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide text in a note so it is not visible until deliberately revealed.
summary: Spoiler block plugin that hides selected information in a note until you click to reveal it.
